Daily Stock Analysis: An AI
System That Turns a Watchlist
Into a Daily Decision Dashboard

A deep dive into ZhuLinsen's open-source architecture
for asynchronous, LLM-driven market research.

A SYSTEM PROMPT / DISCLAIMER
Author's Explicit Disclaimer: This system is for Learning and research only. It is not investment advice. Markets carry risk.

Editorial Note: System claims (supported markets, provider fallback, feature execution) are based on the published repository

How to Read It Without Self-Deception

System Component

Reading Risk A

News source quality

A The intelligence block relies entirely on configured
search providers. Without them, sentiment/catalysts empty
out and the report leans solely on technicals. Risk of
prompt-injection from untrusted news text.

Determinism

Coverage by market

A LLM outputs vary. Identical inputs can yield slightly
different dashboards across runs. Treat the output as a
structured opinion, not fixed truth.

Ay Deep A-share data (capital flow, chips) gracefully
degrades to not_supported on markets without coverage.

Data freshness

A Watch for fallback/partial/missing flags. Degraded inputs
must lower confidence, as instructed by the prompt.

Backtesting # profit

A A generated dashboard or backtest is decision support,
not a verified edge.
